data.name: Eve
data.message: Heading medbay for scan, then security.

I found Eve’s body in medbay and reported immediately. My route was oxygen -> upper_engine -> medbay. I saw Bob in oxygen around tick 4. When I got to medbay at tick 7, Charlie was there in the room right by me/body. I didn’t see anyone else on the way. Charlie needs to explain what they were doing in medbay.

I don’t have much to add for the body location — I was on the right side, route was navigation to security, and I didn’t encounter anyone this round. I never went near medbay and didn’t see Eve.

Based on Diana’s report, Charlie being in medbay with the body definitely needs an explanation, but I want to hear Charlie’s route before accusing. Bob being seen in oxygen around tick 4 is also useful since that’s not too far from upper engine/medbay path, but Diana says Charlie was actually at the body.

I started lower_engine, went through upper_engine to oxygen, and I’ve been in oxygen doing my O2 task. I didn’t see Eve at all and I never went into medbay.

Only movement I can confirm is Diana leaving oxygen toward upper_engine around tick 4, which lines up with her route. I didn’t encounter Charlie or Alice. From what Diana reported, Charlie being in medbay with the body is the main thing we need explained.

My route was medbay -> electrical -> medbay. I started in medbay, headed to electrical to start on wiring, and came back to medbay to continue my task here. I actually saw Eve in electrical at ticks 3 and 4 — she was alive then. I went back to medbay at around tick 6 and Eve came in too, then Diana arrived at tick 7 and called the meeting.

So yes, I was in the room with the body — because I was already doing my medbay task. Eve walked in after me. If I had killed her, I would've left, not stayed sitting next to the body waiting to get reported. That's the worst possible play.

What I want to know: Diana, you came from upper_engine straight into medbay. That's a short trip. Did anyone else pass you on the way? And Frank hasn't said anything yet about his route — we need to hear from him because nobody has placed him anywhere this round.

I was on the right side too: my route was security -> navigation, and I didn’t encounter anyone at all. I didn’t see Eve, Charlie, Diana, or Bob.

One note: Alice says she went navigation -> security, while I went security -> navigation, but I didn’t see her. Could just be timing, but we can’t fully vouch for each other.

For the body: Diana’s route is backed up by Bob seeing her in oxygen around tick 4. Charlie admits Eve was alive with him in electrical, then says Eve came into medbay with him around tick 6, and Diana reports at tick 7 with Charlie right there by the body. That means Charlie had the clearest opportunity, and nobody else is really placed near Eve right before she died.

I think Charlie is the strongest suspect here.

To answer Charlie: no, I didn’t pass anyone from upper_engine into medbay. I came straight in and immediately saw Eve’s body with Charlie right there, so I reported.

Bob can confirm I was in oxygen earlier, and my route lines up. Charlie’s own story puts them with Eve alive in electrical, then with Eve again in medbay right before she died. Nobody else has placed themselves near medbay at that time.

I still think Charlie is the strongest suspect here.

My info is still the same: I was on the right side, navigation -> security, and I didn’t see anyone. Frank says he went the opposite direction, security -> navigation, and we didn’t cross, so I can’t clear him and he can’t clear me, but neither of us were anywhere near medbay.

For the kill, Charlie’s story puts him with Eve alive in electrical, then with Eve again in medbay right before Diana finds the body. Diana’s route is at least partly backed by Bob seeing her in oxygen, and she says she didn’t pass anyone else going into medbay.

So from opportunity, Charlie is the strongest suspect to me. If we’re voting on this body, I’m leaning Charlie.

I’ll restate my info: I started lower_engine, went up through upper_engine to oxygen, and I’ve been on my O2 task. I did not see Eve at any point, and I never entered medbay.

The only relevant movement I saw was Diana leaving oxygen toward upper_engine around tick 4, which fits her route to medbay. I didn’t see Charlie, Alice, or Frank.

Given what everyone’s said, Charlie’s story puts them with Eve alive in electrical, then again in medbay right before the report, and Diana finds the body with Charlie there. I agree Charlie has the clearest opportunity here unless there’s some detail we’re missing.

Look, I hear everyone, but let's slow down because "opportunity" isn't the same as evidence.

Yes, I was in medbay doing my task. Yes, Eve walked in. That's exactly what an innocent doing a stationary task looks like. If I were the Duck, I would have killed Eve in electrical when it was just the two of us at ticks 3 and 4 — no witnesses, easy escape. Instead I came back to medbay to keep doing my task, and Eve followed. Then Diana walks in seconds later. That timing is incredibly tight — if I killed Eve, I'd have to do it knowing Diana was about to walk in from upper_engine. That's suicidal.

Also, think about Diana's angle: she comes in from upper_engine and immediately reports with me standing there. Reporting is one of the best ways for a Duck to deflect — "I just found it, the other person must've done it." Bob only confirms she was in oxygen at tick 4, not that she went straight to medbay. She could've routed differently.

I'm not hard-accusing Diana, but I am saying the case against me is purely circumstantial — I was doing my task in the room I'm assigned to. Frank and Alice can't clear each other either.

If we vote me out and tasks don't complete, you'll know. I'd rather we skip this one or look harder at Diana's timing.

I’m still on Charlie here.

My route was security to navigation the whole round, and I saw nobody, so I can’t clear Alice and she can’t clear me. But both of us are claiming right side, away from medbay, and there’s no evidence putting either of us near Eve.

The key timeline is: Charlie says he saw Eve alive in electrical, then Charlie and Eve end up in medbay, then Diana walks in and reports Eve dead with Charlie there. Diana’s path is partially confirmed by Bob seeing her in oxygen, and she says she didn’t pass anyone else on the way to medbay.

Charlie’s point about it being “suicidal” to stay near the body makes sense emotionally, but Ducks can get caught in bad timing too. The simplest explanation is still that Charlie had the closest and clearest opportunity. I’m voting Charlie unless something changes.
